title: Who’s eating at home tonight? You know without asking.
lead: FamilyGest lightens the mental load of whoever keeps the house running: presence, meals and shopping are shared with the whole family, on everyone’s phone. Even with shared custody.

demo.custodyNext: At the other parent’s from Monday

questions.kids: Are the kids with us this week?

questionsAnswer: With FamilyGest, everyone sees it on their phone, without having to ask.

presence.title: Who’s home, lunch, dinner and night
presence.text: Everyone reports when they are away (or home) in one tap. You always know how many will be at the table, guests included.

meals.title: This week’s meals
meals.text: Plan the menus, find your recipes, and organise meals with guests: they pick the date from a simple link.

shopping.title: One shared shopping list
shopping.text: A single list for the whole family, sorted by aisle, updated live. Menu ingredients are added in one tap.

polls.title: Gathering to organise
polls.text: Suggest several dates; your guests vote on WhatsApp without installing anything.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.text: Share out the tasks, with due dates and reminders.

calendar.title: Family calendar
calendar.text: Appointments, outings, holidays: a shared calendar, exportable to Google or Apple.

voice.title: By voice
voice.text: “Paul won’t be here for lunch tomorrow”: talk to the app or to Alexa.

notifications.title: Always in the loop
notifications.text: Notifications and a daily summary by email, according to everyone’s preferences.

custody.title: Every other week? It’s covered.
custody.text: Everyone sets their usual presence once, day by day, lunch, dinner and night, with a week A and a week B. FamilyGest knows who is home each day: all that is left is to report the exceptions.

points.rhythm: Same rhythm every week, or alternating
points.slots: By day and by meal, nights included

teens.title: Families with teenagers
teens.text: Sport, parties, studies, changing schedules: everyone says whether they are home, and whoever cooks knows how many to plan for.

blended.title: Blended families
blended.text: Week A, week B: presence follows the custody rhythm, with nothing to re-enter from one week to the next.

hosts.title: Families who entertain
hosts.text: Grandparents, friends, weekends: suggest dates, count the guests and prepare the shopping.

moreTitle: And more, to discover along the way

invite.title: I invite you
invite.text: You receive an invitation for your family, and each member creates their account in seconds.

install.title: You install it
install.text: No app store: the app is added to the phone’s home screen in two taps, just like a real app.

organise.title: Everyone gets organised
organise.text: Presence, meals, shopping and calendar fill up during the week, and everyone sees the same thing.

privacyText: A privately hosted family app: no advertising, no data resale. Each family only sees its own information.
finalText: Write to me: I will open a space for your family.
finalTextNoContact: Just ask me: I will open a space for your family.
